name: gtm-strategy
description: Cold-audit GTM strategy flow for IT agencies: from a website URL to stage diagnosis, ICP, competitor gap, positioning, value prop, offers, buyer journey, materials and channels, and a 30-90-180 action plan, with a standalone 23-criteria GTM audit. Outputs to Notion in Ukrainian. Plus 7 research and planning skills (competitor finder, market urgency, persona insights, GTM idea stress test, revenue forecast, growth planner, sales hiring brief) and 3 planning tools (Anthropic, Apache-2.0).
